summary: The relocated canonical contract passes the full independent gate. The live SHA-256 is exact, and replacing the 56 design output-root occurrences with the former public root reproduces the prior accepted manifest SHA byte-for-byte, proving that IDs, categories, evidence statuses, prompts, policies, and geometry briefs did not drift. All 56 canonical outputs now target design/career-world/concepts. The three live generation packets are exact disjoint 19/19/18 partitions of the manifest, their hashes match the plan, and their five eligible same-canonical tracer paths resolve to valid PNG files. No old public concept root exists and no runtime app, feature, or test references either concept root. All prior easter-egg, AI, Atlassian resilience, reference-policy, and distinctness findings remain resolved.
promotion_scope: Promote the manifest to the next gated art-generation stage only. This verdict does not promote generated images, deterministic SVG implementation, 2D runtime QA, or 3D work.

JSON parses. All 56 records contain non-empty id, category, status, evidence_status, output_path, reference_roles, asset_brief, easter_egg_rule, full_prompt, and avoid fields.
56 manifest records equal 56 unique inventory IDs with zero missing, zero extra, and zero duplicate IDs. Counts are world 1, city 5, project 16, skill 27, ambient 7.

All 56 output paths are unique, begin under design/career-world/concepts, and mechanically equal the canonical category directory plus ID slug and -v1.png suffix. Zero manifest or packet outputs remain under the old public root.

The live A/B/C packet counts are 19/19/18. Their ID sets are pairwise disjoint and their union equals all 56 manifest IDs with zero missing, extra, or duplicate IDs. Every packet id, category, output_path, full_prompt, evidence_status, and reference_roles value exactly matches its manifest record. All six identity-only ACE/Column projects explicitly prohibit factual architecture, real-campus implication, systems, metrics, outcomes, skill symbolism, and easter eggs. All prompts prohibit generated text, logos, pseudo-text, unsupported metrics, and watermarks.
Only world/career-world@v1 declares the multi-district exception and five employer anchors. No non-world prompt requests multiple districts.

The reference_policy names exactly five tracer IDs. All five tracer records carry the optional same-canonical tracer policy in reference_roles and full_prompt, including the prohibitions against edit-target, geometry-source, coordinate-truth, and topology transfer. All 51 non-tracer records carry the no-raster-by-default policy and allow only an art-lead-assigned passing same-category style reference with identity, topology, geometry, coordinates, palette ownership, and factual meaning transfer prohibited. All 56 packet input_image_policy objects preserve the same restrictions; only the five exact canonical tracer records have non-null eligible paths.

Exactly five packet records are tracer-eligible: world/career-world@v1, city/ninjaone@v1, project/kaizen-metrics@v1, skill/go@v1, and ambient/evergreen-cluster@v1. Their exact design/career-world/concepts/tracer PNG paths all exist, are non-empty, and have valid PNG signatures; rejected variants are not referenced.

Repository scans found zero concept-root references under app, features, tests, or public. public/career-world/concepts does not exist and contains zero files. The live manifest, packets, plan, full-manifest report, and design concept tree contain zero old public/career-world/concepts references.
